name: Open subtitle sample, edit caption and export
description: Checks the useful local editor workflow without requiring an external AI model download.
steps: Open the AI studio
Inspect language list and choose a language
Click Открыть демонстрационный пример
Edit the first caption text
Click SRT and confirm a subtitle file downloads
Refresh and check the edited caption text is restored
expected: The editor exposes editable captions, subtitle export is available, and text persists after refresh.

name: Empty upload blocks processing
description: Confirms that recognition cannot start without a real file and the mobile layout remains usable.
steps: Open AI-студия on a mobile viewport
Do not upload a video
Type немец in language search and check German appears as an option
Clear language search and switch to Whisper Base
Inspect the Создать субтитры action
Navigate to Как это работает
Select Перевод речи на английский and verify the UI explains that other target languages are not yet supported.
expected: Recognition is disabled without an uploaded media file; language search filters the 99 languages, both model sizes and English translation mode are selectable.

name: Pricing transparently marks checkout unavailable
description: Checks the app explains client-side processing and does not pretend payment works in this beta.
steps: Open Тарифы
Review Local Beta features
Review Cloud Pro planned features
Return to studio
expected: Free beta is clearly available, Cloud Pro is clearly unavailable, and the studio reports on-device processing.

name: Import existing subtitles and export formats
description: A subtitle file can be imported directly without running AI, and is editable and exportable.
steps: Open subtitle import in the studio and select a small valid .srt file with two captions
Verify two captions appear in the editor
Edit the second caption
Download VTT and TXT
Check MP4 button is absent without an uploaded source video
expected: Both imported captions appear for editing and export; video export is offered only when a video is present.

name: Mobile audio loading without unpkg CDN
steps: Confirm /ffmpeg/ffmpeg-core.js and ffmpeg-core.wasm are accessible
Upload a short MP3 or WAV and test browser-native decoder
Upload an MP4 with speech and test FFmpeg fallback if browser cannot decode it directly
Check any error text is shown clearly
expected: No ffmpeg-core.js import from external unpkg CDN; the mobile user can reach Whisper when browser or bundled FFmpeg can decode the file.

name: Burned-in subtitles export and recorded playback
description: Verify an exported video visibly contains subtitle text in the frames, not a selectable track.
steps: Select a short supported MP4 with speech
Import SRT with captions from first second
Use Показать субтитры в предпросмотре
Create new video with text and keep browser in foreground
Play and verify rendered file includes text and sound
Download video and re-open it
expected: Subtitle letters are always visible in recorded video; file can be played and downloaded in a supported format.

name: Actual Whisper ASR with documented English audio example
steps: Click Проверить Whisper на настоящей речи
Confirm audio file test-speech-english.wav is loaded and language English selected
Click Создать субтитры and allow the model to download
Confirm recognizable English transcript appears without an error
expected: Whisper returns real text from the audio sample and creates subtitles; the synthetic demo alone is not considered an ASR test.

name: Paste SRT and VTT with robust timestamp editing
steps: Open Вставить текст SRT / VTT вручную
Paste two valid SRT cues and click Импортировать текст
Verify two rows and exact start/end times
Paste WEBVTT format with 2 cues and verify parsing
Change a start time to exceed its end and verify end adjusts automatically
Paste malformed captions and verify an error is displayed
expected: Both subtitle formats import into editable rows, timing remains valid, and invalid text shows a useful error.
